name: First State Manufacturing
old_description: If you know Sher Valenzuela, you know she likes to put her hands on a good thing and work to make it even better. This is evident in the halls of local and her own home town, Broadkill Beach, where she’s created free lending libraries, a community garden, and annual Christmas tree lightings.
about:
First State Manufacturing operates from Milford, Delaware. The company is led by Sher Valenzuela, who is also active in community development in Broadkill Beach and serves on the board of Downtown Milford Incorporated.

The shop specializes in custom sewing and fabric fabrication, serving military, aerospace, industrial, and medical markets. Capabilities include military sewing and contracting, industrial covers, disaster relief products, transportation and rail covers, fleet services, and aircraft covers. The facility offers on-site high-pressure blasting and cleaning services, and the company emphasizes its design engineering support through product engineering services.

Customers span defense, aviation, pharmaceutical, medical, safety, transportation, rail, and fleet sectors. The company lists NSN search and government contracting among its services, indicating a focus on military and federal supply chains.

First State Manufacturing highlights its limitless design capabilities and on-site finishing services as differentiators. Valenzuela’s community leadership reflects a culture of hands-on problem solving that extends to client projects.
